)

data class GroupSessionFinishReadinessResponse(

)

    val setsTotal: Int,
    val blocksCompleted: Int,

    val leftAt: Instant?,

    val avatarUrls: List<String?>,

    @get:JsonUnwrapped val session: GroupSessionResponse,
    val leftOut: List<ParticipantUserResponse>,
)
